boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Skidmore environments for individual work, group projects, research, writing, and media-based coursework.

cards.title: Lucy Scribner Library
cards.subtitle: 815 North Broadway, Skidmore College
cards.notes: Start with the library’s added seating areas and study carrels, then move to a group room when your work shifts from reading to collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with seating, carrels, group rooms, collections, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucy Scribner Library’s renovation added seating areas, study carrels, and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: About the Library | Lucy Scribner Library
cards.access_notes: The library is open to the public; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Creative Corridor
cards.subtitle: Lucy Scribner Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the flexible seating here when you need to spread out materials or talk through a shared assignment without treating the space as a silent room.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library redesign centered on flexible, collaborative seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Creative Corridor provides group and flexible spaces and seating intended to foster collaboration and creativity.
cards.access_notes: Located in Scribner Library; check library access hours before going.

cards.title: Scribner Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lucy Scribner Library, floors 1–3
cards.notes: Reserve a room through LibCal for a focused two-hour group session, and plan around the rule that reservations open only 24 hours ahead.
cards.short_summary: Bookable library rooms for scheduled collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Students, faculty, and staff can reserve most library study rooms on floors 1–3 up to 24 hours ahead in two-hour blocks.
cards.source_title: How do I reserve a study room? | Ask Us
cards.access_notes: Skidmore students, faculty, and staff reserve via LibCal; reservations are limited to 24 hours ahead and two-hour blocks.

cards.title: Scribner Library Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Lucy Scribner Library
cards.notes: Choose a carrel when you want a defined solo-work setup, then keep shared materials in the library’s group rooms rather than occupying a larger space.
cards.short_summary: Individual workstations added through the library’s renovation.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2012 library renovation added 12 new study carrels.
cards.source_title: About the Library | Lucy Scribner Library
cards.access_notes: Confirm library access hours before visiting; carrels are part of the library’s study seating.

cards.entity_name: Skidmore GIS Center for Interdisciplinary Research
cards.title: Skidmore GIS Center for Interdisciplinary Research
cards.subtitle: Lucy Scribner Library, second floor, Room 227
cards.notes: Bring a mapping or data project and use the center’s specialized PCs for ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, R Studio, or Metashape during posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated geospatial research lab with 19 high-power computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The GIS Center houses 19 high-power PCs with ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, R Studio, and Agisoft Metashape.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; the center is in Library Room 227.

cards.title: MDOCS DOCLab
cards.subtitle: Scribner Library 113
cards.notes: Stop by during staffed lab hours for documentary or audiovisual work, using the Mac Pro lab, recording booth, or virtual-reality setup for a project.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on media and documentary workspace inside Scribner Library.
cards.evidence_claim: DOCLab in Library 113 includes a Mac Pro computer lab, sound recording booth, and modular virtual-reality setup.
cards.access_notes: The page lists staffed hours Sunday–Thursday, 4–10 p.m.; private consultations are also available.

cards.title: The Attic
cards.subtitle: Filene Hall
cards.notes: Request this MDOCS workspace when an audio, exhibit, or documentary assignment needs an intentional production setting beyond a standard study table.
cards.short_summary: An MDOCS production workspace for archive and exhibit planning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Attic in Filene Hall is an MDOCS workspace with recording space, suited to archive and exhibit planning.
cards.access_notes: Reserve the space for a meeting, class, or workshop, or request all-hours access for an independent project.

cards.title: Philip Boshoff Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Lucy Scribner Library, fourth floor, Room 440
cards.notes: Schedule a one-on-one conversation when you need to brainstorm, organize, draft, or revise; bring the assignment sheet and any relevant materials.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor writing-support space staffed by trained student tutors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center offers one-on-one consultations with trained student tutors at every stage of the writing process.
cards.access_notes: Appointments use Skidmore credentials; it is located in Scribner Library Room 440.

cards.entity_name: Lanzit Center for Computers and Writing
cards.title: Lanzit Center for Computers and Writing
cards.subtitle: Palamountain Hall 302
cards.notes: Use the multiple computer stations for an academic or personal writing project, but verify that the room is not currently assigned as a classroom.
cards.short_summary: A computer-equipped writing workspace in Palamountain Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: When it is not in use as a classroom, the Lanzit Center provides multiple computer stations for student writing projects.
cards.access_notes: Available when not being used as a classroom; location is Palamountain Hall 302.

cards.title: Burgess Café Computer Area
cards.subtitle: Case Center
cards.notes: Use the Case Center computers for email or short computer tasks, especially when you need an all-hours campus location rather than a library room.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Case Center computer area for basic campus computing.
cards.evidence_claim: Case Center is open 24 hours and provides computers for checking email in the Burgess Café.
cards.access_notes: The College catalog states that Case Center is open 24 hours and has Burgess Café computers.
